result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.trav_out_until()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Traverse outward node-by-node until stopping conditions are met. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L6588-L6743){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.trav_out_until( conditions, max_steps=30, exclude_unmatched=True, add_to_selection=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} From the currently selected nodes, moves along outward edges to connected nodes, continuing until reaching nodes that satisfy the condition or until `max_steps=` is reached. The traversal proceeds in a breadth-first manner. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [conditions]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [callable]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A function that takes a node ID (str) and returns `True` if the stopping condition is met for that node. The callable can access node attributes via `graph.get_node(node_id).attributes`. [max_steps]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[30]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Maximum number of traversal steps (node-to-node hops) before stopping. [exclude_unmatched]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, only nodes satisfying the conditions are kept in the final selection. If `False`, all reached nodes are kept. [add_to_selection]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, all traversed nodes are included in the final selection. If `False`, only the final nodes are selected. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Starting from node `1` of a 10-node path and walking outward until hitting the node whose `value` attribute equals `8` stops exactly there, skipping every node in between: ::: {#486c4680 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_path_graph(10) for i in range(1, 11): graph.set_node_attrs("value", {str(i): i}) node_ids = list(graph.get_node_ids()) (graph .select_nodes_by_id([node_ids[0]]) .trav_out_until(lambda nid: graph.get_node(nid).attributes.get("value") == 8) ) graph.get_selected_node_ids() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [8] ``` ::: ::: Starting from multiple nodes traverses each independently, so the result combines whichever node first satisfies the condition along each path: ::: {#5ccfc883 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph(directed=True).add_path_graph(10) for i, nid in enumerate(graph.get_node_ids(), start=1): graph.set_node_attrs("value", {nid: i}) node_ids = list(graph.get_node_ids()) (graph .clear_selection() .select_nodes_by_id([node_ids[0], node_ids[1]]) .trav_out_until( lambda nid: graph.get_node(nid).attributes.get("value", 0) >= 5, max_steps=10 ) ) graph.get_selected_node_ids() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` [8, 4] ``` ::: :::
